race.comment: BROADWAY STREET (5) returned from a three-month spell in a similar race at Newcastle 16 days ago and was denied by the barest margin after rattling home out wide. Sparingly raced four-year-old who looks to be back better than ever and is poised to make it career win number two. LEGO MASTER (6) went around as a $2.30 favourite but after racing on the speed offered little at the end of 1400m at Newcastle last time out. Best form reads kindly so he should be given another chance. HARRY LIME (11) took a sit then went home a shade too well on debut over 1200m at Wyong recently. Gives every indication that an extra 200m will be right up his alley. DIRTY SUMMER (2) found 1100m a bit sharp when a distant third to a subsequent city winner at Hawkesbury last start. Finds a more suitable race today and should be in the finish.
